about_the_game:
Introducing Dark Mode DLC for Borderless Gaming!

An optional DLC to help fund and support the free/open source version of Borderless Gaming. If you wish to acquire dark mode, you can get it for free on Github. See more information here.

Overview


This DLC brings a highly requested feature to Borderless Gaming: Dark Mode. Experience your favorite application with a sleek, eye-friendly dark theme that extends throughout the entire interface. The design remains true to the original, maintaining the intuitive layout and functionality you know and love, but with a modern, dark twist.

Features


  • Seamless Integration: The Dark Mode DLC integrates flawlessly with Borderless Gaming, transforming your app experience with a single click.
  • Eye Comfort: Reduces eye strain in low-light conditions, perfect for those late-night gaming sessions.
  • Sleek Design: Retains the original design and functionality of Borderless Gaming, now with a stylish dark theme.
  • Easy to Toggle: Switch between Dark Mode and the traditional light theme easily within the app settings.
